name: discover-the-divine-removes-four-enlighten-counters-to-level-up
notes: Discover the Divine: remove four enlighten counters to level up. Pre-fix the counters were never removed ($champMZ undefined) but the level-up still happened.

rulesClauses: You may remove four enlighten counters from your champion. If you do, level up your champion.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Discover the Divine: the generated handler ($champMZ) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
